projects.title: Healthcare Claims Data Warehouse, ETL Mapping
projects.description:
Designed a Medicare claims data warehouse consolidating source systems and file specifications, building ETL mappings and BI report specifications that reduced requirements validation effort by 40% across a 4-sprint Agile project management cycle.
Achieved zero critical defects at UAT sign-off by authoring test plans and traceability matrices across 130+ source-to-target fields, validated through SQL-based test data creation and verification queries.
Gathered business and technical requirements across data subject areas by leading structured requirements workshops, analyzing entity relationship diagrams and database models to produce a phased ETL work breakdown structure.
